import sqlite3

def filter_high_totals(db_path, min_total):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute(f"SELECT category, SUM(amount) as total FROM sales GROUP BY category HAVING SUM(amount) > {min_total}")
    results = cursor.fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return results
